**Before filing against the exposure model**
If this concerns MED values, burn times or SPF handling, please read
docs/EXPOSURE-MODEL.md first, in particular the units section. The MED table is in
erythemally weighted J/m², which is not comparable to the unweighted mJ/cm² figures
reported by solar-simulator studies. That mismatch has already produced one false report.
